title: Spending forecast charts on the home screen
summary: An AI assistant built spending forecast charts that predict the next three months of spending and balances, and placed them on the home screen for everyone. (Example project.)
bluf: Spending forecast charts that predict the next three months, built and placed on the home screen for everyone. Forecasts are welcome, but the home screen is where first-time budgeters start, and Personal App Idea keeps advanced tools like this in the opt-in Advanced view. Decision needed: ask for a revision that moves the charts into the Advanced view?

touched.reason: The charts appear on the home screen for everyone. Advanced tools belong in the opt-in Advanced view until most people who use that view rely on them and first-time budgeters understand them without help, and neither has been tested.
The forecast totals are checked against six months of test budgets before release, so the numbers are finished before they ship.

decision_needed: Ask for a revision that moves the charts into the Advanced view?
